answers.goal: My goal is to build globally recognized entertainment properties that create opportunities for others. Whether that's through live experiences, film, music, or strategic partnerships, I'm interested in building things that last. Personally, I want to continue growing as an artist, producer, and entrepreneur while developing platforms that elevate emerging talent and create meaningful cultural experiences around the world.
answers.drew: I've always been drawn to entertainment because of its ability to bring people together and create lasting impact. I started as an independent artist and discovered that music could open doors far beyond a song itself. Today, my work sits at the intersection of music, live experiences, film, hospitality, and community building. I'm most energized by creating platforms that connect artists, fans, brands, and institutions in meaningful ways.
answers.seeking: I'm looking to connect with builders and collaborators across entertainment—artists, executives, producers, investors, creatives, and founders who are passionate about creating culturally meaningful work. I especially enjoy meeting people who think across industries and are interested in long-term partnerships rather than one-off projects.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is less about one individual and more about people who've successfully bridged creativity and entrepreneurship. I've always admired those who have built platforms bigger than themselves—creating opportunities for others while continuing to push culture forward. That's ultimately what I aspire to do through my work.
